faqs: What is IGNITE?
IGNITE is a Hong Kong-headquartered direct-selling company with an e-commerce platform and independent Brand Affiliates.
What product can I explore here?
This website currently features brAInify. Open Products in the navigation to explore its learning paths and AI-assisted approach.
Where can I find training?
Visit Training & Events for learning topics, then contact our team for session dates and joining details.
How do I join or access my account?
Use Login in the navigation to open the official distributor portal. Contact IGNITE for registration guidance in your market.
Where are the official policies?
Browse summaries of IGNITE’s global policies. Contact our team for complete documents and terms applicable to your market.
How do I ask about an order?
Contact global support with your order reference and question. Check the official return and shipping policies for the applicable conditions.

sections: How AI is used
IGNITE uses generative AI to help prepare text, visuals and marketing materials, with human review.
